messages.subject: Re: problem with embedding links in table
parts: After fixing syntax errors in test_table_url everything worked. There are no issues with links in tables at all.

output$test_table_url <- renderText( {
    str <- "<table border = 1>"

str <- paste0(str, "<tr>")
      str <- paste0(str, "<td>", "<a href='http://google.com'>google</a>", "</td></tr>")
    }
    str
  })

That said, I still prefer generating tags for tables myself for more flexibility with applying CSS like centering text in columns or cell conditional formatting based on content. Also there are interactive and sortable tables like googleVis and Foo Tables. The latter never worked for me and ones from google do not display correctly in Chrome (what an irony).

On Friday, July 12, 2013 7:00:16 PM UTC-4, Allan Strand wrote:
As the subject says, I'm trying to embed hrefs in cells of a table.  As far as I can tell, there are two threads on this group that describe approaches:

1) write out a table in html in a renderText() function and use htmlOutput() to display
2) use renderTable() and make sure to redefine the xtable sanitize.text.function() to not escape references.

I've tried both and have not been successful. I suspect that I'm just doing something silly, but I'm not sure what it is.  I've attached test versions of server.R and ui.R.

ui.R tries to display three tables, (two that create html code and one that uses renderTable()) but only the first (the one without links) seems to work 

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.
cheers,
Allan


ui.R
#################
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("HTML output"), 
  sidebarPanel(sliderInput("n", 
    "Number of on each side:", min = 0, max = 10, value = 5)), 
    mainPanel(
        htmlOutput("test_table")
        ,
        htmlOutput("test_table_url")
        ,
        tableOutput("test_table_url2")
        )
))

server.R
#########################
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$test_table <- renderText( {

        str <- "<table border=1> "
        for (i in 1:input$n) {
          str <- paste(str, "  <tr> ", sep = "")
          str <- paste(str, "    <td>",i,"</td>", sep = "")
        }
        str
    })
    
    output$test_table_url <- renderText( {

        str <- "<table border=1> "
        for (i in 1:input$n) {
          str <- paste(str, "  <tr> ", sep = "")
          str <- paste(str, "    <td>","<a href 'http://google.com'>google<\a>","</td>", sep = "")
        }
        str
    })

output$test_table_url2 <-  renderTable(
    {
        tab1 = data.frame(x = c('a'), y = c('<a href="http://google.com">google</a>'))
        tab1
    }, sanitize.text.function=function(x){x})
    
})
